"""Camera-guided Panda history-book extraction. Only rcb_client controls hardware.
All executed joint targets are saved in actions.jsonl, providing an exact replay.
"""
import json,argparse
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation,Slerp
from rcb_client import Robot
from kin import fk,ik
OUT=Path('/app/output');r=Robot()
R_GRASP=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[1,0,0.]])
def observe(name='obs',depth=True):
 res=r.get_obs(include_depth=depth,video='none');res.save(OUT/name);return res

def execute(A,name):
 A=np.asarray(A)
 with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'actions':A.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
 res=r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.1,cameras=None,video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
 res.save(OUT/name);print(json.dumps(res.meta));return res

def move(p,name,seconds=4.,rotation=R_GRASP,finger=None):
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none');s=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);q=s[:7];t=fk(q)
 finger=float(np.mean(s[14:16])) if finger is None else finger
 interp=Slerp([0,1],Rotation.from_matrix(np.stack([t[:3,:3],rotation])))
 A=[]
 for a in np.linspace(0,1,int(seconds*10)+1)[1:]:
  b=a*a*(3-2*a);pos=t[:3,3]*(1-b)+np.array(p)*b
  q=ik(pos,interp([b]).as_matrix()[0],q);A.append(np.r_[q,finger,finger])
 return execute(A,name)

def grip(width,name,seconds=2):
 s=np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now']);A=np.tile(np.r_[s[:7],width,width],(int(seconds*10),1));return execute(A,name)

if __name__=='__main__':
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('mode',choices=['observe','move','grip','replay']);p.add_argument('--name',default='obs');p.add_argument('--pos',type=float,nargs=3);p.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=4);p.add_argument('--width',type=float,default=None);args=p.parse_args()
 if args.mode=='observe':observe(args.name)
 elif args.mode=='move':move(args.pos,args.name,args.seconds,finger=args.width)
 elif args.mode=='grip':grip(args.width,args.name,args.seconds)
 elif args.mode=='replay':
  for line in (OUT/'actions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
   a=json.loads(line);res=r.submit('joint_position',a['actions'],dt=a['dt'],video='none')
   if res.done:break
